summary: Regression testing passed for landing, six-case library, registration, protected sessions/progress, live Emergent LLM response, irrelevant-question gating, and mobile layout.
critical_code_review_comments: The scorecard UI currently exposes only completion and XP banner; detailed score dimensions/feedback returned by the API are not rendered, so the full scorecard product requirement remains unverified/incomplete.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ prefixed accounts and incomplete sessions; no seeded production data modified.
test_credentials: No credentials were present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md; temporary accounts were generated during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Protected Authorization header defect and Library/Session error handling are resolved. Six starts, live chat, relevance response, progress endpoint, and mobile overflow passed. Verify completion by inducing a valid SCORE_JSON response and inspect XP persistence plus detailed scorecard rendering.
rca of the issue: The prior Authorization injection defect is fixed by Header() declarations on protected route parameters. The prior uncaught case-start issue is fixed with in-app error handling. Existing pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported; running pytest without sourcing frontend/.env fails before making a request due to an empty BASE_URL, which is test-environment configuration rather than an application failure.
